text: Merge an acquired company's data pipeline without breaking customers' trend lines
originalText: Merge an acquired company's data pipeline without breaking customers' trend lines

text:
Key decisions
- Run both on the same inputs
  for weeks (shadow / dual run)
- Define tolerance per metric
  before comparing
- Mapping table for ids and brands
- Cut over tenant by tenant
  behind a flag
- Mark the switch on charts so
  trends stay explainable
